meta.description: Processes Sendblue delivery-status callbacks idempotently by message_handle. Alerts on repeated failures, auth errors, line failures and rate limits. Never resends because a status callback repeated.

options.$comment: Update-by-handle is naturally idempotent: a repeated callback rewrites the same row and NEVER triggers a resend. Unmatched handles (inbound RECEIVED events, foreign messages) fall through the error branch and are ignored.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $env.SLACK_ALERTS_CHANNEL_ID, text: `:warning: Sendblue delivery alert — ${$json.kind}: ${$json.detail} (handle ${$json.message_handle || 'n/a'})` }) }}

nodes.name: Ignore Unmatched Handle
nodes.notes: Status events whose handle we never sent (e.g. inbound RECEIVED) are ignored — never resent, never alerted.
